hero.description: Milestis turns your photos into an interactive book you can actually finish — no design skills, no subscription cliff, just a page that’s really yours.
hero.imageAlt: An open interactive photo book page

manifesto.quote: Nobody remembers a folder of raw files. Everyone remembers a story.

steps.title: Pick a template
steps.description: Choose a structure that already knows how to look good — spacing and hierarchy are solved before you start.

steps.title: Add your photos
steps.description: Drop in your best shots. AI handles the cropping, pacing and layout for you, instantly.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.description: Swap a palette, add a caption, adjust the pacing — the structure never breaks no matter what you change.

steps.title: Publish & share
steps.description: One link. No app to download, no account required for anyone to view it.

items.title: Unbreakable layouts
items.description: Every template is pixel-tested. However you rearrange it, the composition never falls apart.

items.title: Depth & atmosphere
items.description: Light, shadow and parallax give every page a sense of real physical space.

items.title: Curated palettes
items.description: Dozens of ready palettes, or build your own from a single photo in your book.

items.title: Interactive animations
items.description: Pages that respond to scroll and touch, so reading feels like turning real pages.

items.title: One shareable link
items.description: No login wall for your readers — just a link that works everywhere.

items.title: Event stories
items.description: Turn a wedding, a trip or a birthday into a book your guests will actually open again.

items.title: Instant portfolios
items.description: Freelancers and creators use Milestis as a portfolio that updates itself in minutes.

items.title: Photographer upsell
items.description: Studios hand clients a finished, branded gallery instead of a folder of raw files.

cta.title: Your photos deserve better than a folder.
